notes: Landscape site slip, Light half only: Light Force icon at left, banner •ENDOR: EWOK VILLAGE (red dot), icon boxes, Light text with an inline Light Force icon → {light-force}. No scomp. The slip prints no Dark text, so dark_text holds the PRINTED Dark text read off the 490 px scan; the printed Dark half has a Dark Force icon → dark_force true. ICON ORDER: the slip's light boxes read (outermost first) planet, interior (beige room corner), exterior (purple sky with sun) — the printed card's Light and Dark bars both read planet, exterior, interior; i.e. the slip swaps interior/exterior. light_icons follows the slip, dark_icons the printed card. Printed Light text was 'No starships or vehicles here. Ewok devices and Ewok weapons deploy -1 here.' No margin credits. Sites have no lore. Base scan Endor-L-endorewokvillage.gif (490×350, the only one). Copyright Endor 1999 (partly legible). Modern: V8-L-endorewokvillage.gif (1039×745, but that is the VS8 Dark-side remake with different Dark text — art only); VB3 (490) also exists.
